name: GoGet car share student membership
summary: Discounted GoGet car share membership for full-time students, signing up with a student email address.
who: Full-time students get the discounted membership.
You need a valid driver's licence and must meet GoGet's other criteria. Under-25s can join.
how: Sign up online with your student e-mail address, then download the app.
catches: Drivers with less than 1 year's independent driving face some restrictions.

evidence.quote: Discounted membership for full time students
